responsibility: Defines GCC’s REAL_VALUE_TYPE representation and the public interface to the compiler’s internal floating-point subsystem. It describes real_value and real_format, target-format metadata, constant real globals, target encoding macros, and the APIs for constructing, converting, rounding, comparing, truncating, printing, and querying floating-point constants that are implemented by real.cc and used throughout tree folding, RTL constants, and range analysis.
same_name_distinction: Defines REAL_VALUE_TYPE, real_format, constants, macros, and the public APIs for GCC’s internal floating-point subsystem; unlike gcc/real.cc it is the declaration and representation header, and unlike gcc/realmpfr.h it covers the full real-constant interface rather than just MPFR interoperation.
